summary.text: Heath Kufahl is the Republican candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 54, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Crystal Abram-Garcia in an open-seat race.

paragraphs.text: Heath Kufahl advanced to the general election by winning the June 16, 2026 Republican primary over Alexander Torvi and Philip Lancaster.
